# `saddlepoint`

`saddlepoint` provides a general framework for saddlepoint approximation
(SPA) where distributions and model components are represented by
cumulant generating functions (CGFs) and their derivatives. It supports
saddlepoint likelihood evaluation and parameter estimation for composite
and high-dimensional constructions.

Saddlepoint methods use the CGF
$K(t) = \log{\mathbb{E}}\left\lbrack \exp(tX) \right\rbrack$ to build
accurate approximations to likelihoods, densities, and tail
probabilities.

## Key functionalities we provide

- CGF objects for common families (e.g., Poisson, Gamma, Gaussian,
  Binomial, Negative Binomial, Multinomial).
- Operators to build new CGFs by composition (e.g., i.i.d. replication,
  linear maps, sums, random sums, tilting operations, etc).
- Likelihood tools for saddlepoint-based inference, including workflows
  for maximum likelihood estimation.
- Error/discrepancy computations

## Quick start: saddlepoint MLE for a simple model

``` r

library(saddlepoint)
set.seed(1)

y <- rnorm(60, mean = 2, sd = 1.5)

fit <- find.saddlepoint.MLE(
  observed.data  = y,
  cgf            = NormalCGF,
  starting.theta = c(mu = 0, sigma = 1),
  lb.theta       = c(-Inf, 1e-8),
  ub.theta       = c( Inf, Inf),
  method         = "two_step",   
  std.error      = TRUE
)

fit$MLEs.theta
fit$std.error
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BinomialCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/BinomialCGF.md)
  : Binomial CGF Object

- [`BinomialModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/BinomialModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Binomial CGF Object

- [`EsscherTiltCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/EsscherTiltCGF.md)
  : Esscher / Exponential Tilting of a CGF

- [`ExponentialCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/ExponentialCGF.md)
  : Exponential CGF Object

- [`ExponentialModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/ExponentialModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Exponential CGF Object

- [`GammaCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GammaCGF.md)
  : Gamma CGF Object

- [`GammaModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GammaModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Gamma CGF Object

- [`NormalCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GaussianCGF.md)
  [`GaussianCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GaussianCGF.md)
  : Univariate Normal CGF object

- [`NormalModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GaussianModelCGF.md)
  [`GaussianModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GaussianModelCGF.md)
  : Create a parametric univariate Normal CGF

- [`GeometricCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GeometricCGF.md)
  : Geometric CGF Object

- [`GeometricModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/GeometricModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Geometric CGF Object

- [`MultinomialCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/MultinomialCGF.md)
  : MultinomialCGF

- [`MultinomialModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/MultinomialModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric MultinomialCGF Object

- [`MultivariateNormalModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/MultivariateGaussianModelCGF.md)
  [`MultivariateGaussianModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/MultivariateGaussianModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Multivariate Normal CGF Object

- [`NegBinCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/NegBinCGF.md)
  : Negative Binomial CGF Object

- [`NegBinModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/NegBinModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Negative Binomial CGF Object

- [`PoissonCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/PoissonCGF.md)
  : Poisson CGF object

- [`PoissonModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/PoissonModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Poisson CGF Object

- [`SubunitaryMultinomialCGF`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/SubunitaryMultinomialCGF.md)
  : SubunitaryMultinomialCGF

- [`SubunitaryMultinomialModelCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/SubunitaryMultinomialModelCGF.md)
  : Create a Parametric Subunitary Multinomial CGF Object

- [`adaptCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/adaptCGF.md)
  : Create an adapted CGF object using an adaptor function

- [`adaptor()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/adaptor.md)
  :

  Create an `adaptor` object

- [`compute.saddlepointLL.correction()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/compute.saddlepointLL.correction.md)
  : Compute the correction term for the saddlepoint approximation to the
  log-likelihood

- [`compute.spa.negll()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/compute.spa.negll.md)
  : Compute the saddlepoint negative log-likelihood

- [`compute.std.error()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/compute.std.error.md)
  : Compute standard error and inverse Hessian

- [`concatenationCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/concatenationCGF.md)
  : Concatenation of CGF objects

- [`createCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/createCGF.md)
  : Create a CGF object from user-defined functions

- [`createCGF_fromVectorisedFunctions()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/createCGF_fromVectorisedFunctions.md)
  :

  Create a `CGF` object from vectorized functions

- [`find.saddlepoint.MLE()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/find.saddlepoint.MLE.md)
  : Find maximum likelihood estimates using the saddlepoint likelihood.

- [`get.ineq.constraint.function()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/get.ineq.constraint.function.md)
  : Create the inequality constraint function

- [`get.saddlepoint.eq.constraint.function()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/get.saddlepoint.eq.constraint.function.md)
  : Create the saddlepoint equality constraint function

- [`get.saddlepoint.nll.function()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/get.saddlepoint.nll.function.md)
  : Create the saddlepoint negative log-likelihood function

- [`get.zeroth.saddlepoint.nll.function()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/get.zeroth.saddlepoint.nll.function.md)
  : Create the zeroth-order saddlepoint negative log-likelihood function

- [`iidReplicatesCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/iidReplicatesCGF.md)
  : Replicate a CGF object over multiple i.i.d. blocks and/or with a
  fixed block size

- [`linearlyMappedCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/linearlyMappedCGF.md)
  : CGF Object of a linearly mapped random variable \\Y = A \\ X\\

- [`randomlyStoppedSumCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/randomlyStoppedSumCGF.md)
  : CGF for a randomly-stopped sum

- [`saddlepoint`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/saddlepoint-package.md)
  [`saddlepoint-package`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/saddlepoint-package.md)
  : saddlepoint: A framework for the saddlepoint approximation with CGF
  operations

- [`saddlepoint.solve()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/saddlepoint.solve.md)
  : Numerical saddlepoint equation solver

- [`sumOfIndependentCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/sumOfIndependentCGF.md)
  : CGF Object for the sum of independent random variables

- [`sumOfiidCGF()`](https://godrick.github.io/saddlepoint/reference/sumOfiidCGF.md)
  :

  Create a CGF object for the sum of `n` i.i.d. random variables.
